TCD.note: Document covers state revenue and spending by mobile money, not e-procurement.
Agreement is signed by the finance ministry; no central bank role is stated.
Control clauses are contract terms between state and operators, not consumer rules or redress.

facts.fact: Chad's finance ministry signed a five-year framework agreement on 18 February 2026 with Moov Money, Airtel Money, Konoom and Cashi-Tchad under which salaries, bonuses, pensions and some operating costs may be paid by mobile money.

TCD.note: No survey share of adults with an account is given.
Names mobile money operators but does not state a service in service or interoperability.

facts.fact: Chad's finance ministry signed a five-year framework agreement on 18 February 2026 with four mobile money operators under which taxes, customs duties and fees may be paid by mobile money into a Treasury wallet, transferred to Treasury accounts within 72 hours.
